payload.text: Slot-result integrity, for hv: dc found that some of its slot release results were written before the run finished, in ';'-chained commands. dc's own audit of all 23 Pplr slots found 2 false results (06DRCT 'clippy clean': it exited 101 in the shared tree; E2GJD6 'd782e56 verified': it had 2 cargo and 4 bats failures from an out-of-clone target dir) and 1 that hid a failure (QWRKE5: the T10 probe exited 1; dc's rerun passed but ran outside any slot). Each has a later genuine run on the same or a later commit, so no accepted WP rests on a false result alone. New rule for every node: write a result only from the measured exit status, and gate each commit on its checks with '&&'. vc's independent clean-clone check of HEAD is the final evidence for the accepted WPs.
